item.title: How José Zúñiga Built a Multi-Million-Follower YouTube Brand
item.description:
How José Zúñiga Built a Multi-Million-Follower YouTube Brand

José Zúñiga did not build Teaching Men’s Fashion through luck. He engineered it. As of late 2026, the channel commands over 5.4 million followers across its primary English-language platform and its Spanish-language counterpart, Estilo De Hombre. This scale represents a significant outlier in the men’s lifestyle niche. To replicate this success, one must understand the specific mechanics behind the brand’s architecture: publishing consistency, visual distinctiveness, and rigorous audience segmentation.

item.title: Who Is José Zúñiga? The Origin Story and Business Breakdown of Teaching Men's Fashion
item.description:
Who Is José Zúñiga? The Origin Story and Business Breakdown of Teaching Men’s Fashion

José Zúñiga is a Honduran-American entrepreneur and digital creator who redefined the landscape of men’s grooming and style education. While often recognized by his massive online following, his journey represents a strategic evolution from early social media experimentation to a diversified e-commerce and media enterprise. This article details the Teaching Men’s Fashion origin story, providing a transparent look at the José Zúñiga biography, content strategy, and business growth that established him as a leading authority in men’s lifestyle.
